brand.name: Grow Your Childcare
brand.tagline: Grow Your Childcare — Marketing That Works for Childcare Centers
brand.mission: Help childcare centers grow through smarter marketing, sales, and client experience.

primary.name: Bright Violet
primary.usage: CTAs, highlights, active states, brand accent

typography.notes: Avenir is the brand font. Always prefer it over system fonts in print/presentation contexts.

voice.tone: Direct, confident, warm. Not corporate. Not casual.
voice.audience: Childcare center owners and directors — time-poor, results-focused, skeptical of agencies
writingRules: Lead with the outcome, not the process
Speak to the owner, not the industry
Avoid jargon unless the audience uses it themselves

logo.notes: Upload logo files to /brand/logos/ using the media uploader below.
logo.clearspace: Maintain clear space equal to the height of the G in GYC on all sides
dontDo: Don't stretch or distort the logo
Don't place on busy backgrounds without a container
Don't use the logo in unapproved colors
Don't recreate the logo in other fonts

mediaLibrary.notes: Brand media, photography style guidelines, and approved assets
photoStyle: Real childcare environments preferred over stock
Children's faces: ensure proper permissions before use
Team photos: professional but approachable, not overly formal
Brand colors should be present (clothing, backgrounds, or UI elements)
